subject.title: [Bug] v2026.6.11 published dist missing reentrancy guard - reply session initialization conflicted

question: Should maintainers publish a stable hotfix/rebuild for the affected v2026.6.11 package, or wait for the next stable release while marking v2026.6.11 affected?
rationale: Automation can verify the source/package mismatch, but only maintainers can choose the release vehicle and user-facing handling for a latest-stable package that is already published.

options.title: Publish a stable hotfix
options.body: Rebuild from a fixed source commit, run a stable install/package smoke that proves dist reentrancy support, and close this issue with the released version evidence.

options.title: Wait for next stable
options.body: Keep this issue open and document v2026.6.11 as affected until the next stable release carries the fixed bundle.

options.title: Split remaining variants
options.body: Keep this canonical package issue for release parity and move restart-recovery or channel-specific retry leftovers into narrower issues.

recommendation.title: Publish a stable hotfix
recommendation.body: Rebuild from a fixed source commit, run a stable install/package smoke that proves dist reentrancy support, and close this issue with the released version evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman merged the current source-side fix and is the strongest available owner signal for deciding the release follow-through on that fix.
